name: Lotus Reverie: First Nexus
source:
One day without any notice The Incident happened, causing the vanishing of almost all the citizens by unknown means or reason. Their numbers were reduced to less than 0.1%. Among the chaos, two great changes came together crashing down on their lives with a new paradigm:

First, Tulpa came to existence. These beings look and act just like anyone else, however they are born through the subconscious mind of another human called the host, and their lives are linked in several different manners:

-- Even though they look human in every aspect they are actually semi-immortal. They cannot die by normal means, but in exchange their lifespans are very limited.

-- If the human host dies, the tulpa will also die, and vice versa. For this very reason they are forced to cooperate with each other if they want to stay alive.

-- The only way to extend their lifespans is by fighting and killing another Tulpa and their host in a duel. This is the only moment where a Tulpa loses their immortality and becomes vulnerable.

The second great change came with a huge monolith that towers up as far as the eye can see standing where the royal palace was supposed to be. This monolith has inscribed six rules making clear only one thing:
From among all the remaining people in Maya, only one human and their Tulpa can survive.

[From [url=https://www.lotusreverie.com/]Keinart Lobre[/url]]
translation:
有一天，在没有任何通知的情况下，事件发生了，导致几乎所有公民以未知的方式或原因消失。他们的数量减少到不足0.1%。在混乱之中，两个巨大的变化一起以一种新的范式摧毁了他们的生活：

首先，Tulpa诞生了。这些生物的外表和行为与其他人一样，但他们是通过另一个称为宿主的人类的潜意识诞生的，他们的生活以几种不同的方式联系在一起：

——尽管他们在各方面看起来都是人类，但实际上是半永生的。他们无法通过正常方式死亡，但作为交换，他们的寿命非常有限。

——如果人类宿主死亡，tulpa也会死亡，反之亦然。正因为如此，如果他们想活下去，就必须互相合作。

-- 延长它们寿命的唯一方法是在决斗中与另一只Tulpa及其主人战斗并杀死它们。这是图尔帕人失去永生并变得脆弱的唯一时刻。

第二个巨大的变化是一座巨大的巨石，矗立在原本应该是皇宫的地方，一望无际。这块巨石刻下了六条规则，只明确了一件事：
在玛雅剩下的所有民族中，只有一个人和他们的图尔帕人能够幸存。

[来自[url=https://www.lotusreverie.com/]Keinart Lobre[/url]]
